reviews.title: Works great and is plug-and-play.
reviews.comment: Second one I've installed--both have been easy plug-and-play. Possibly I should have entered the BIOS, but the memory shows up, and I tend to avoid messing with the BIOS as much as I can get away with. I'm pretty good with computers, but am always afraid of bricking a computer somehow if I play around too much with the BIOS, so it's always a last resort to me, unless the computer automatically does it for me.
